Here at Beechworth Carriage Motor Inn we are passionate about Beechworth and its history. When you explore beautiful Beechworth and Victoria's High Country from your base at our Beechworth Carriage Motor Inn, rest assured you will be well cared for at the end of each exciting day!
Out & About
Explore
We are only steps away from many heritage listed buildings and surrounded by majestic liquid amber elm trees. We overlook the historic Loddon hotel (now a private residence) and only 200m from the Post Office, Historic Precinct and Visitor Information Centre.

Beechworth Carriage Motor Inn Group Motel Accommodation Family Rooms
About
Your host Brian Smith has been in the hospitality industry since 2001. He knows that his welcome and how he looks after your group will reflect on your company or group. We strive to ensure our service is second to none.
On our first visit to Beechworth, we fell in love with this beautiful town and its picturesque surrounds. It seemed natural that after seven years in the accommodation industry in Ballarat, we would move here to take over the Beechworth Carriage Motor Inn, bringing with us a wealth of experience and knowledge to make your group's stay with us truly memorable.
Cycle Friendly
Beechworth Carriage Motor Inn is one of Beechworth's most cycle friendly motels. With a 3.5 star motel rating, we assure your comfort and convenience.
Visiting Beechworth
Guests will be able to experience the living history of the gold rush era including the infamous Ned Kelly, as well as a wide range of fine dining, quality clothing and boutique shopping, exceptional food and wine and boutique beer. Not to mention breath-taking cycling along the Murray to Mountain Rail Trail or skiing adventures in the nearby Victorian Alps.
When choosing your motel accommodation stay at Beechworth Carriage Motor Inn. Our guests find themselves in the very heart of this exciting and endlessly fascinating region. Beechworth is Victoria's best preserved gold mining town. Explore Victoria's High Country and rest assured you will be well looked after at the end of each exciting day.
Visiting Beechworth
Our Location
Accommodation specialist, Beechworth Carriage Motor Inn, is conveniently located at the quiet residential end of Camp Street. Surrounded by majstic liquid amber elm trees overlooking the historic Loddon Hotel, now a private residence. Yet we are only 200 metres from the Post Office.
Beechworth Carriage Motor Inn is only 4 hours from Melbourne and 6 hours from Sydney via the Hume Freeway. So why not rediscover Beechworth and the High Country of North East Victoria.

Motel Beechworth Victoria Carriage Motor Inn Central Accommodation
Rooms
At the Beechworth Carriage Motor Inn we value our history and the heritage of our town and want to share this with you. We have tried to stay true to the integrity and style of the original buildings with their open brick walls and high timber ceilings and we want you to experience, see and feel the history of this property whilst not compromising on today's luxuries.
You will love our clean, comfortable heritage style rooms. We've included lots of little extras so you will feel at home as soon as you walk in the door. All our rooms are ground floor and we have an early midday check in available. Leave your car with us and walk to the myriad of shops and activities. We have secured bike storage, coach and bus parking available.
